intro_walkthrough: Establish the editor with an unsnapped HUD element visible.
outro_walkthrough: Hold on the cleanly aligned HUD.

source.before: Placing a HUD element meant nudging it into line by eye.
source.after: A snap magnet pulls the element onto nearby alignment guides.
source.value: Players can build a clean HUD without hunting for individual pixels.

treatments.text: Your HUD elements can now snap cleanly into line, without all the pixel hunting.
walkthrough: Show a HUD element sitting away from an alignment guide.
Drag the element toward the guide until the snap magnet engages.
Hold on the element aligned cleanly to the guide.
